profile.input_contract: JSON pendulum initial q/p and step parameters.
profile.output_contract: JSON observables q, p, and scalar energy.
profile.adapter: Cloud-safe Python runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p4/.

mrs.description: P4 Hamiltonian pendulum live launcher slice: an identity follow-up preserves the scalar Hamiltonian energy while the runner also emits imported q and p observable series.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Inv MR: the identity follow-up must preserve Hamiltonian energy for the deterministic P4 surrogate.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply Identity to the full input document and run source/follow-up through the same pendulum adapter contract.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe scalar `energy`; the runner also emits imported observables `q` and `p` for provenance parity.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `approx-invariant` checks source and follow-up energy equality within a tight deterministic tolerance.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: ToleranceRel=1e-12 and ToleranceAbs=1e-12 pin the identity-invariance claim.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable to the cloud-safe Minimum-MR-SubSet P4 surrogate sample under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p4/sample/canonical.json.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates that the P4 runtime promotion, adapter mapping, or Hamiltonian energy contract disagrees with the staged import metadata.
